rounds.notes:
### 💫 POWERS

[The Whambulance](item_67e91029-d0fc-4c9d-9733-ec7e1cc064a9) 
- This Power is the **core** of this build. This allows you to **burst heal**, and **damage boost** much more often, since you have another source of healing. Make sure to get the mandatory items listed below.

### ⚔️ ITEMS

⚠️ Make sure to get the items marked with ✨ first, in order.

####  

#### 🔸 IF YOU HAVE UNDER $22k
In this case, I would suggest getting [Angelic Acrobatics](item_baad85fc-3da5-43af-ad9d-f17885f59aa5) with some [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power). This item makes it so you can burst heal much more often, but without another item to boost your Staff's healing, such as [Mark of the Kitsune](item_09a53e39-25aa-4f66-ba51-bedbc543a1eb), [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) or [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed) is a better choice at the moment. As for [Ability Power](stat_ability_power), [Long Distance Wings](item_8b4bafad-c8bc-4c77-bbe7-798b03920c88) is a great cheap item to use for this build.

####  

| Item | Description |
| ------------ | ------------ |
| [Angelic Acrobatics](item_baad85fc-3da5-43af-ad9d-f17885f59aa5) | ✨ **S18 PATCH ADDED [Ability Power](stat_ability_power)**. Synergizes with [The Whambulance](item_67e91029-d0fc-4c9d-9733-ec7e1cc064a9) and gives you insane movement and survivability |
| [Mark of the Kitsune](item_09a53e39-25aa-4f66-ba51-bedbc543a1eb) | ✨ Burst of healing from your Staff as soon as you use Guardian Angel, which will boost your Staff's healing output altogether |
| [Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8) | This is one of [Mercy](hero_0e213bfc-3ca9-49c6-9036-e7f344b752da)'s best **Survivability** items. You will get healed simply by using Guardian Angel. Don't under estimate how strong this item is! |
| [Long Distance Wings](item_8b4bafad-c8bc-4c77-bbe7-798b03920c88) | Synergizes with [The Whambulance](item_67e91029-d0fc-4c9d-9733-ec7e1cc064a9) by allowing you to fly from further away to heal a greater amount |
| [Ironclad Exhaust Ports](item_2d085fa5-ace6-4fab-9323-b7a06268bcd0) | If you are getting constantly damaged, or are dying a lot, this synergizes really well with [Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8), giving you a total of 75 HP every time you use Guardian Angel |

### 💫 POWERS

Explanations coming soon as for which Power to choose.

Short description for now: I really like the new Power [Supply Surge](item_35d75d9e-66b7-426a-b92d-9dfd72ee5fbb) for giving cooldown reduction to teammates, or [Distortion](item_5557e2f2-02df-4eac-8128-0c23b71183b1) if you have good DPS, so you can damage boost them more often. You can pick another power depending on your playstyle. If you need more healing, go for [Triage Unit](item_fec0554c-2685-4b93-822d-bf0020e654b4).


### ⚔️ ITEMS

#### ⚠️ Make sure to get the items marked with ✨ first, in order.

- **Why?** I strongly believe [Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8),   [Angelic Acrobatics](item_baad85fc-3da5-43af-ad9d-f17885f59aa5) and [Mark of the Kitsune](item_09a53e39-25aa-4f66-ba51-bedbc543a1eb) are ✨ **mandatory**  to get the best out of [The Whambulance](item_67e91029-d0fc-4c9d-9733-ec7e1cc064a9).
- 🎯 **Your Goal?** Use Guardian Angel as much as possible! With these items, you will get healed by 50 ([Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8)), and be able to burst heal with your Staff ([Mark of the Kitsune](item_09a53e39-25aa-4f66-ba51-bedbc543a1eb)), as soon as you use Guardian Angel. When it ends, you will burst heal once more. Having [Angelic Acrobatics](item_baad85fc-3da5-43af-ad9d-f17885f59aa5) synergizes very well, by allowing you to trigger these effects much more often, as well as gaining movement speed.

####  

#### 🔸UNDER $32k?
If you don't have $32k by now, you can try swapping [Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8) with [Ironclad Exhaust Ports](item_2d085fa5-ace6-4fab-9323-b7a06268bcd0).
